notes: herself is marked added under rule 44: the clause writes no nepeš and no object suffix, and the Qal ʾāsərāh is not a reflexive voice the pronoun could realize.
being is read as the construction-supplied copula of the prepositional predicate and joins the bêṯ preposition under rule 49, headed on in.
In her father's house the suffix takes her directly under rule 18; the possessive expression carries the possessor's determiner, so nothing is supplied on the construct.
